"Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"Please — tell me you've got food to spare. I'm going hungry here. I can't keep going like this."

sayLines.line: 🧳 A traveler swears Stonebridge, south, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. Stonebridge is starving.)
📺 They heard you. They held the line longer than wisdom allowed — for you, for the noise, for the cameras. The crowd is quieter now.

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."
🌧️ The storm rolls over Haven like a held breath let go — rain hammering the tarps, the wind testing every knot Aroha tied. Inside, it's almost cozy. Almost.
